1. Noise $z\sim p(z)$ in; fake sample in data space out.
2. $\mathbb{E}_{x\sim p_{\mathrm{data}}}[\log D(x)]$ and $\mathbb{E}_{z}[\log(1-D(G(z)))]$.
3. Assign high probability to real $x$ and low to fakes $G(z)$.
4. Generator covers only a few modes of the data distribution (low diversity).
5. No — they are implicit samplers without a tractable density in general.
